# react-native-roster

> A React Native read surface for layered intervals with provenance across lanes
> and a shared time axis. API not yet shipped. Pure core types, geometry, coverage,
> caches, axis helpers, Roster, and useRoster are implemented; Schedule and the adapter are planned.

## Vocabulary

| Term | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| roster | The whole read surface: a shared time axis, lanes, and layers. |
| lane | One person or resource row containing layers, a label, and optional metadata. |
| layer | A named, ordered set of intervals and gaps with a role, z-order, and style. |
| interval | Covered absolute time, `[start, end)` in epoch milliseconds, with sources. |
| gap | Removed absolute time with sources; survives complete subtraction. |
| source | Provenance identified by `(kind, id)`; its label is display metadata. |
| window | A bare absolute `{ start, end }` span; resolution belongs to the axis. |
| projection | Geometry mapping: horizontal for a roster, columns for a schedule. |
| adapter | A function outside the core that converts upstream data into lanes and layers. |
| schedule | One lane projected into days across and wall-clock hours down. |

## Contract

The authoritative contract is issue #3. A lane contains layers; a layer contains
covered intervals and removed gaps. Both carry `sources: Source[]`. Absolute time
is epoch milliseconds and end-exclusive. Source identity is `(kind, id)`; labels
never participate in equality. A window is only `{ start, end }`.

`LayerRole` values are `availability`, `booking`, and `custom`. A projection is
horizontal (roster) or columns (schedule). Layout works only on visible lanes;
coverage works on every lane. Target-warm means the exact requested cache keys
already exist; target-cold means they do not. Rule, lane, and view timezones have
separate jobs. The core uses standard JavaScript and `Intl`; recurrence expansion
and Temporal belong exclusively to the future adapter.

## Entry points

- `react-native-roster`: Roster, useRoster, default zone fillers, rendering types, and core re-exports.
- `react-native-roster/core`: pure types, geometry, coverage, axis helpers, and counters.
- `react-native-roster/rrule`: planned recurrence adapter; empty today.
- `react-native-roster/package.json`: package metadata.

Metro resolves the `react-native` condition to TypeScript source. Other runtimes
resolve the default condition to emitted CommonJS. Type declarations live in dist.
No `.js` extensions on relative imports in src. No consumer-specific entities.

## Core usage constraints

- `layoutLane(lane, window, projection)` is for visible lanes; `coverageFor(lane, window)` is for every lane.
- `flagFor` honors explicit flags, infers only `empty-in-window`, and never infers `never-set` or completeness.
- Geometry preserves exact bounds and source sets, applies inset, and splits at column and transition scale boundaries.
- Columns use local `x` coordinates and `rect.column`; repeated time has two half-height sub-regions.
- `timeAtY` returns an epoch time or null. Horizontally, `timeAtX(projection, window, x)` returns an epoch time at true elapsed length; the window supplies the origin the projection lacks.
- `snapToStep` floors in the view zone and clamps at transitions; the step must be a positive divisor of 60.
- `WindowSpec` supports day, week, month, and custom spans. Use windowFor, prev, next, and today; week starts Monday by default.
- Month navigation clamps short-month anchors. Day columns have full local-day bounds, English weekday labels, localDate, and transitions. Skipped dates have no column.
- Cache keys use lane id, version or a canonical structural layers encoding, window, and all projection fields. Coverage excludes projection. Lane display metadata and completeness never enter keys.
- Bump version when layers change. Treat returned references as read-only. Flags and coverage are assembled fresh while rects are reused.
- layoutStats and coverageStats count runs and cacheHits; resetStats clears counters only. clearLayoutCache and clearCoverageCache clear keys only.
- The deterministic workload fixture emits 70 rects plus gap rects per lane per week: 63 rects and 7 gap rects. Workload W has 200 lanes, two layers, 24 visible lanes, and 15-minute ticks.
- Intl formatToParts supplies zone offsets. Hourly transition probes are refined to millisecond boundaries. No Temporal, recurrence, or React imports in core.

## Roster usage constraints

- Give Roster a bounded viewport. The hook owns coverage for every lane; geometryFor calls the content-cached layout only when mounted lanes request it. Wire onLayout in custom layouts.
- Ticks derive wall steps arithmetically across day transitions and cache by window bounds, timezone, span, minuteStep, and pxPerMinute. Identical tick inputs return the same array without Intl calls.
- The default label column is 180 px, rows are 48 px, and horizontal scale is at least 0.5 px per elapsed minute. rowHeight and pxPerMinute are configurable.
- Body scroll drives Reanimated shared x and y values. Vertical scrolling never updates React state. All lane labels share one translated column. LegendList extraData keys window, projection, highlight identity, and rect zone fillers. Reanimated is an optional peer for core-only installs, required for rendering.
- All eight zone props are render functions: emptyZone, laneLabelZone, headerCellZone, intervalZone, gapZone, headerZone, laneLabelColumnZone, and bodyZone. Default fillers are exported from the root.
- intervalZone supplies a View positioned by rect bounds and z; gapZone fills an already positioned pressable. Default gap content is null.
- press chooses intervals, then gaps, then snapped empty space; highest z and later-layer ties win. Only one callback fires. highlightSource compares kind and id.
- byLabel is the default comparator. byCoverage accepts measure availability or availabilityMinusBooking, sorts descending, and breaks ties by label.
- complete is lane.complete ?? true. incompleteLabel defaults to Availability may be incomplete; neverSetLabel defaults to No availability set.
- The seven gallery routes use static test fixtures and offer span, step, view timezone, and sort controls. Expo SDK 54 experiments.reactCompiler is enabled. window.__roster exposes live layoutStats, coverageStats, resetStats, clearLayoutCache, and clearCoverageCache functions with stable bridge identity. Only on-screen counters sample every 500 ms. Fixture records own zones and showsEmptyExample.
- iOS and Android scrolling and React DevTools LaneRow render counts still need the device pass.
